name: Amazon CVG1 Fulfillment Center Hebron KY

fieldNotes.truckGate: 2024-09 Street View shows a continuous black chain-link security fence (Amazon-added; absent in 2016/2021 panos) wrapping the trailer yard and dock apron, breached by a single controlled entry drive off Worldwide Blvd at the north end. Fence + single gated opening into the secured yard = controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard-booth footprint positively confirmed at the gate throat in satellite (z20-21) or Street View; entrance trees partially obscure. A small structure sits on the dock apron but reads as a yard-control/equipment shed, not a road-side gatehouse. Marked false with low confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no confirmed booth -> treated as kiosk/app check-in (Amazon driver app). Uncertain; could flip to guardShack if a manned booth exists behind the tree line.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron/yard inside the fence between the gate and the dock doors provides ample internal queueing room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entry drive descends a long ramp from Worldwide Blvd into a deep internal yard; easily holds 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entry/exit drive off Worldwide Blvd at the north; the drive has a center median splitting in/out lanes but is one gate point.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Center median at the entry suggests ~1 in / 1 out; exact lane count obscured by trees - estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and a deep, wide internal yard give physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single continuous dock bank runs the full ~520m east face; no trailers backed in to count individually, but a 1M+ sq ft FC of this length implies well over 50 doors. Count 110 is an order-of-magnitude estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long row of marked angled trailer-parking stalls runs the full east drop yard (~90-stall capacity); mostly empty in captured imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (Prologis Park West) in Hebron KY beside the I-275/I-71-75 interchange; broader setting is exurban/rural-industrial, not dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors are on a single (east) building face; west face is roof/employee-parking only. One dock cluster.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~42 acres derived (shoelace) from the traced 7-vertex perimeter ring (building + east drop yard + dock apron + west employee lot + entry drive); approximate.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Live 2024-09 panos exist on Worldwide Blvd overlooking the gate (perimeter/truckGate hasCoverage true); panos nearest the interior drop yard/dock apron resolve to 2016 pre-Amazon imagery, so those zones marked hasCoverage false. pano ids left empty per instruction (never invent).
